verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a code-hosting platform can surface external CI results as commit and PR status checks. However, nothing in the pack documents a commit status or Checks API, or shows external CI results appearing on commits or pull requests. The closest items are third-party CI apps listed in the Marketplace, generic CI/CD marketing that points to GitHub Actions, and general REST API references. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not evidence of this capability.
